subject: QBR flight‑check: forecast rollup + account ledger updates
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QBR flight‑check: forecast rollup + account ledger updates

Team —

We need a concise sweep of the sales ledger ahead of next week’s QBR. Attached are two templates: QBR_account_briefs.xlsx (account‑by‑account one‑pager) and forecast_rollup_template.csv. Please do the following by Friday EOD (UTC):

1) For each account you own, update the one‑pager with current ARR/ACV, expected close date, committed vs. best‑case, and a one‑line rationale for the confidence level (green/amber/red).
2) Fill the rollup template with committed amount only; add a separate column for 'confidence_score' (1–5).
3) Flag the top 2 blockers (legal/Pricing/POC/infra) and required next action with owner and ETA.

OKR note: for the QBR deck we will include a 1‑slide summary of pipeline health (win rate by segment, forecast accuracy vs. target, and top 10 at‑risk deals). If any account materially changes ARR or timing, call it out in the comments column and ping me.

I pushed a Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR-2027/forecast-rollup — use that for uploads. If you need me to reassign any accounts, say so now.

Attachments: QBR_account_briefs.xlsx, forecast_rollup_template.csv

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

I'll also include a short 'risk rationale' sentence in each one‑pager (no more than 2 lines) so the exec slide can pull verbatim text.

Attaching: segment_assignment.csv

-Markus

- NovaBank: pushed from 7/22 to 8/31 (best case) — confidence 3/5

I can split up the remaining accounts with Karthik if needed. Also: I'll add a 'Top‑2 Asks' field per account as requested.

Cheers,
Tessa
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: QBR flight‑check: forecast rollup + account ledger updates

Quick asks from Prod/Rev on format before we consolidate:
- Please include HubSpot deal link and our internal deal_id on every row (helps CS and Finance crosswalk).
- Add a short 'forecast confidence method' tag: historical conversion / exec commitment / verbal OK.
- Can we run a quick forecast accuracy check vs. last quarter after the rollup? I can run the script if you upload the raw close dates to the Drive.

I'll join the consolidation sync on Friday if we need to triage by account. Also suggest we color‑code deals >250k for the exec slide.

-Karthik
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acme.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T09:48:00-07:00
Subject: FW: QBR flight‑check: forecast rollup + account ledger updates (Acme confirmation)

Sarah —

Tessa is compiling the Acme one‑pager for our QBR and has Acme listed as committed with ACV $180,000 and target close date 2027‑08‑18. Can you confirm that the commercial terms are still on track and whether legal has a target for returning the final SOW? If there's any slippage, let us know the new expected date and whether an internal exec review is required.

We plan to include a one‑line risk rationale on the exec slide; for Acme Tessa flagged 'legal contract wording outstanding'. A confirmation sentence from you would be great.

Attachments: (see initial templates in earlier thread)

Best,
David
